info.title: RightsFlow AI API
info.description: Music rights, publishing administration and royalty accounting API. All tenant data lives under `/api/v1/organizations/{organization_id}/...` and requires an active membership in that organization.

get.description: Provider configuration, plan entitlement and this month's usage.

post.description:
Admin: send one minimal real request to verify the provider (counts as one AI request).
Fails with the same classified errors as other AI endpoints.
Answer a question grounded in the organization's catalog records.
Interpret a natural-language query as filters and run a real database query.
Ask the AI for metadata cleanups; valid proposals become pending suggestions.
Compare two records. Advisory only: nothing is merged.
Plain-language explanation of a rights conflict. The conflict is not changed.
AI summary of the deterministically detected anomalies.
Suggest a source category and column mapping for a statement export.
Figures computed from the database plus an AI executive narrative.
Apply a pending suggestion's whitelisted, re-validated changes.

get.description: Deterministic duplicate candidates from the catalog module.
Rule-based royalty anomaly detection (no AI).
Deterministic metadata completeness scores for works, recordings and releases.

post.description: Create an account and send an email-verification link.
Authenticate and issue an access token plus a rotating refresh token.
Rotate a refresh token. Each refresh token can be used exactly once.

Revoke the current session. Accepts the refresh token, the access
token, or both.
Change password; all other sessions are revoked and a new pair issued.

get.description: Return the currently authenticated user's profile.

put.description: Remember the organization the user is working in.

schema.title: Response List My Sessions Api V1 Auth Me Sessions Get

get.description: Which notifications are also sent by email (in-app notifications are always kept).

Which organization and scopes this key grants. Workflows call this first
instead of hard-coding an organization id.
API, database, credential expiry, outbox backlog and recent failed runs.

post.description:
Record a workflow failure. Every failure is logged; admins are alerted once
per incident (grouped by workflow, error category and resource) with a
suppression window, escalation and a recovery notice (N8N-03).

get.description: Automation's processing state for one statement (attempts, retry time, category).

post.description:
Lease up to ``limit`` due events. Acknowledge each with the returned
``lease_token`` before the lease expires, or it becomes claimable again.

Upload a statement through the same validation as the app (file type,
size, archive safety, parsing). Every distinct file (by SHA-256) gets an
explicit outcome: ``imported``, ``duplicate`` (200 with the existing
statement; automation can't override duplicate protection) or ``rejected``
(4xx, recorded once with a review task).

get.description: With ``wait_seconds``, waits (bounded) until processing has finished.

post.description:
Counts of unmatched/invalid lines and lines *held* by the royalty engine
(missing or ambiguous contract terms, disputed ownership...). Raises or
refreshes a review task and notifies managers once per finding set.

get.description:
Active/pending contracts ending within ``within_days`` (or already past
their end date). Ids and dates only.

post.description:
Send one reminder per (contract, end date, threshold) to managers and
above; repeats return ``duplicate: true`` without notifying again.

Queue the existing report job for a completed month (once per type and
period). Poll ``GET /automation/jobs/{job_id}``, then send.

Review any subject (work, recording, party, rights conflict) and, if given,
acknowledge the outbox event that asked for it.

Ask the AI layer for metadata cleanups. Results are stored as *pending*
suggestions and a review task; nothing changes until a person approves.
Close metadata review tasks whose suggestions a person has decided.

get.description:
Mode, connection status and every automation the organization can switch
on, with its settings, schedule, next and last run.

put.description:
Switch an automation on or off and/or change its settings. RightsFlow
sets it up in n8n in the background (status ``pending`` until then).

post.description: Start an enabled automation now; its run appears in the run history.
Check and repair everything RightsFlow set up in n8n now.

get.description: A run with links to what it produced (statements, review tasks, notifications, report files).

schema.title: Response List Credentials Api V1 Organizations  Organization Id  Automation Credentials Get

post.description:
Create an automation API key for this organization. The returned token
is shown once; only its HMAC is stored.

Recovery after the n8n data folder was reset or moved: forget the bound
instance so the new one can use the key. Confirm the old instance is gone
first; otherwise rotate the key instead (N8N-07).
Dead-letter recovery: put a dead event back in the queue.
Close an incident by hand (e.g. the workflow was retired). A new failure opens a new one.

get.description: Automation processing state per statement (retry_waiting, needs_manual_review, ...).

post.description: Manual retry: reset automation's attempt counter and process the statement now.
Queue an automated (AI-assisted) review of a catalog item or rights conflict.

get.description:
Public plans ordered by ``sort_order``. Development plans are marked
and have no price until commercial pricing is configured.

schema.title: Response List Plans Api V1 Billing Plans Get

get.description: Subscription, usage against plan limits and feature flags.

put.description:
Change the subscription plan (owner only).

Manual provider: applied immediately once current usage fits the new
limits; nothing is charged. Configured payment provider: returns a
checkout URL; the plan changes when the provider confirms payment.

post.description:
Start a payment-provider checkout. Returns ``503 billing_not_configured``
when no provider is configured.

get.description:
AI usage (tokens, estimated cost) by month and feature, statement
imports by month, and current storage.
Search parties by name, legal name, IPI or ISNI; filter by role and type.

delete.description: Delete an unreferenced party. Referenced parties return 409; archive them instead.

Archive/restore (manager) or delete (admin) many items at once.
Missing, already-in-state and referenced items are skipped with a reason.

get.description:
Deterministic metadata problems (invalid/missing identifiers, works
without writers, recordings without ISRC or linked work, ...).
Likely duplicates (same identifier, or similar normalized titles).

schema.title: Response Duplicates Api V1 Organizations  Organization Id  Catalog Duplicates Get

get.description:
CSV export. Cells that could be read as spreadsheet formulas are
prefixed with an apostrophe.
CSV template with the expected headers and one example row.

post.description:
Upload a CSV/XLSX file and queue a background import. Re-uploading the
same file returns the existing job (``deduplicated: true``).

schema.title: Response List Imports Api V1 Organizations  Organization Id  Catalog Imports Get

get.description: Import status, progress and per-row results.
Change history (audit log) of one party, work, recording or release.

get.description: Work with contributors (party names), linked recordings and completeness.

parameters.description: Create/update even when another item has the same identifier

post.description:
Merge a duplicate catalog item into a survivor (admin).

Operational references move to the survivor; posted financial history is
not rewritten; the duplicate is archived with a note (never deleted).

get.description:
Search (title, reference, party name), filter, sort (title, end_date,
start_date, created_at) and paginate contracts.

Active / pending-signature contracts ending within ``within_days``
(default: the organization's warning window), soonest first. Includes
contracts past their end date that have not been marked expired yet.

schema.title: Response Expiring Contracts Api V1 Organizations  Organization Id  Contracts Expiring Get
Response List Documents Api V1 Organizations  Organization Id  Contracts  Contract Id  Documents Get

post.description:
Upload a contract document (pdf, docx, txt, png, jpg). The extension and
file signature are validated; the stored name is generated server-side.
Deterministic keyword/regex clause scan (works without AI).

Queue an AI-assisted extraction of a contract document. Returns 503
``ai_not_configured`` when no AI provider is configured.

schema.title: Response List Analyses Api V1 Organizations  Organization Id  Contracts  Contract Id  Analyses Get

post.description:
Accept or reject an analysis. On accept, only the fields listed in
``apply_fields`` are re-validated and copied onto the contract.

get.description:
Reported royalties per month of ``statement.period_end``; months without
data are zero.
File metadata (never the internal storage location).
Jobs for this organization, newest first.

post.description: Cancel a job that has not started yet (status ``queued``).
Re-queue a failed or cancelled job with a fresh attempt budget.

get.description:
Outbound email for this organization, newest first. ``delivered`` is
true only for ``sent``; ``logged`` emails were NOT delivered.
The current user's notifications, newest first.

post.description: Mark every unread notification as read (optionally for one organization).

get.description: Pending invitations addressed to the user's (verified) email.

schema.title: Response My Invitations Api V1 Invitations Mine Get

post.description: Public: show which organization an invitation link is for.

get.description: List active organizations the current user belongs to, with their role.

schema.title: Response List My Organizations Api V1 Organizations Get

post.description: Create an organization and assign its creator as owner.

get.description: Return organization details for an authorized member.

post.description: Deactivate the organization (data is retained). Owner only.

get.description: List organization members. Inactive members are visible to admins.

schema.title: Response List Organization Members Api V1 Organizations  Organization Id  Members Get

post.description:
Transfer ownership to an active admin. Requires the owner's password
and the organization slug as explicit confirmation. The previous owner
becomes an admin.

schema.title: Response List Invitations Api V1 Organizations  Organization Id  Invitations Get

post.description: Re-send a pending or expired invitation with a new link (old links stop working).

get.description:
Organization activity history. Viewers and managers see business
activity for a specific entity; the full security log requires admin.
Statement of account with running balance (oldest first).

schema.title: Response Payee Ledger Api V1 Organizations  Organization Id  Payees  Payee Id  Ledger Get

get.description: Balances for every payee with ledger activity, per currency.

post.description: Record a recoupable advance (a negative ledger entry recouped from future earnings).
Draft a batch paying each eligible payee's available balance (whole cents).

Record that the approved batch was paid OUTSIDE RightsFlow. Writes
negative payout entries to the ledger. Requires explicit confirmation.

get.description: Every reference list in one response (for client-side caching).

schema.title: Response Get All Reference Data Api V1 Reference Get

get.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 territories, preceded by ``WORLD``.

schema.title: Response Get Territories Api V1 Reference Territories Get
Response Get Rights Types Api V1 Reference Rights Types Get
Response Get Source Categories Api V1 Reference Source Categories Get
Response Get Currencies Api V1 Reference Currencies Get
Response Get Party Roles Api V1 Reference Party Roles Get
Response Get Contributor Roles Api V1 Reference Contributor Roles Get
Response Get Release Types Api V1 Reference Release Types Get
Response Get Contract Types Api V1 Reference Contract Types Get

get.description:
List ownership shares with filters. ``territory`` returns shares whose
scope covers that country (WORLD-wide shares included unless excluded).

post.description:
Create a share. Returns the share, the asset's validation summary and
the conflicts currently detected for the asset. Rejected (422) when it
would violate a blocking split rule.

patch.description:
Edit an unverified share in place. Verified shares only accept notes /
contract changes; anything material requires ``/supersede``.

delete.description: Archive a share (shares are never hard-deleted).

post.description: Create a new share replacing this one (old status -> superseded).

put.description:
Atomically replace the active share set of one rights type. The new set
is validated as a whole; blocking rule violations reject everything.

get.description:
Effective ownership per rights type on a date (default today), with
totals per territory group, controlled vs non-controlled percentages and
validation issues.
Rights history: audit entries for every share (any status) of the asset.

post.description: Dry-run validation of a proposed share set. Nothing is written.

schema.title: Response List Split Rules Api V1 Organizations  Organization Id  Rights Split Rules Get

post.description: Create a rule; an org-wide conflict re-scan is queued in the background.

Create shares from the sheet's entries for the given rights types,
territories and dates (source = split_sheet).

Re-run detection for one asset or the whole organization. Conflicts
that are no longer detected keep their status (never auto-resolved).
Human review of a conflict. ``resolve`` and ``dismiss`` require notes.

get.description: Supported statement formats and the canonical fields columns map to.

post.description:
Upload a CSV/XLSX statement. Identical files are rejected (409) to
prevent double counting. Returns the statement with a suggested mapping.
Record manual adjustments or licensing income without a file.

patch.description:
Edit statement details. Locked once royalties are posted; changing the
category, default rights type or period discards unposted calculations.

post.description: Queue parsing, validation and matching as a background job.
Cancel queued processing (not possible once the worker has started).

Match many lines at once — either explicit ids or every unmatched line
sharing the ISRC / title (/ artist) of ``key_line_id``.
Re-run automatic matching for unmatched lines (e.g. after adding catalog items).

get.description: Unmatched lines across unposted statements, grouped by identifier/title.

post.description: Calculate royalties for a processed statement (does not touch the ledger).

schema.title: Response Run Summary Api V1 Organizations  Organization Id  Royalties Runs  Run Id  Summary Get

post.description: Recompute the run from current data and report whether it reproduces.
Post payable allocations to the payee ledger (admin).
Reverse a posted run with offsetting ledger entries (history is kept).

get.description: Liveness probe.
Readiness probe: verifies database connectivity.

AIConnectivity.title: AIConnectivity
AIConnectivity.description:
Whether the provider actually answered, judged from this organization's own requests.
``configured`` only means settings are present.

resource.title: Resource
resource.description: What failed, e.g. the n8n node name; part of the incident key

ContractUpdate.title: ContractUpdate
ContractUpdate.description:
Partial update. Nested lists, when present, replace the current set
(royalty terms with a matching ``id`` are updated in place).

EmailLogResponse.title: EmailLogResponse
EmailLogResponse.description:
Outbound email record. Bodies are not exposed: they can contain
single-use links (invitations, password resets).

token.title: Token
token.description: The full API key. Shown only once; store it in n8n now.

ManagedAutomationUpdate.title: ManagedAutomationUpdate
ManagedAutomationUpdate.description:
Switch a managed automation on/off and/or change its settings (merged
over the current ones; validated per automation).

MoneyByCurrency.title: MoneyByCurrency
MoneyByCurrency.description: ``amount`` is in ``currency``; other currencies are listed separately.

period.title: Period
period.description: YYYY-MM; defaults to the previous month

OrganizationMemberRoleUpdate.title: OrganizationMemberRoleUpdate
OrganizationMemberRoleUpdate.description: Request to update an organization member's role.

OrganizationSettings.title: OrganizationSettings
OrganizationSettings.description: Behavioural settings stored on the organization.

narrative.title: Narrative
narrative.description: Executive narrative that only uses the supplied figures; no new numbers.

caveats.title: Caveats
caveats.description: Data limitations the reader should know about.

recipient_user_id.title: Recipient User Id
recipient_user_id.description: Defaults to every admin and owner

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Business key, e.g. 'monthly:2026-09'. A run that already succeeded with this key is returned instead of starting a new one.

ShareUpdate.title: ShareUpdate
ShareUpdate.description:
In-place edit. Material fields of a verified share cannot change here;
use the supersede endpoint instead.

controlled_party_ids.title: Controlled Party Ids
controlled_party_ids.description: Parties whose shares are controlled by the organization. Defaults to every entry being controlled.

calculate.title: Calculate
calculate.description: Calculate a draft (unposted) run so held amounts are visible. Never posts.

StatementUpdate.title: StatementUpdate
StatementUpdate.description:
Editable statement details. Currency can only change before processing
(lines inherit it); every field is locked once royalties are posted.

include_existing.title: Include Existing
include_existing.description: Add the asset's current active shares (for the proposed rights types) to the proposed set instead of replacing them.
